```{r include=FALSE}
source("./scripts/scripts.R")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = F,warning = F,message = F, fig.height = 5.5, fig.width = 7)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)


fn_plot_all <- function(temp1){
  plot1 <-
    temp1 |> 
    select(model,data,power) |>
    mutate(power_ratio = power/sort(power)[2] ) |> 
    arrange(power_ratio) |>
    mutate(model = as_factor(model)) |> 
    unnest() |> 
    ggplot(aes(or, power, col = model)) +
    geom_point(alpha = .3, show.legend = F) +
    geom_line(data = temp1 |> 
                select(model, polygon_upper) |> 
                unnest(), 
              show.legend = F)
  
  plot2 <-
    temp1 |> 
    select(model, polygon, power) |> 
    mutate(power_ratio = power/sort(power)[2] ) |> 
    arrange(power_ratio) |>
    mutate(model = as_factor(model)) |> 
    unnest() |> 
    ggplot(aes(or, power, fill = model)) +
    geom_polygon(alpha = .5, col = "gray10", show.legend = F) +
    geom_label(data = temp1 |> 
                select(model,power,or_025) |> 
                mutate(or_025 = min(or_025)) |> 
                arrange(power) |> 
                mutate(model = as_factor(model),
                       y = 1 - (1:n() - 1)/10,
                       power = round(power,5)),
              mapping = aes(x = or_025,y = y,label = power),hjust = 0,show.legend = F)
  
  temp2 <- 
    temp1 |> 
    select(model, polygon, power, power_std) |> 
    mutate(power_ratio = power/sort(power)[2] ) |> 
    arrange(power_ratio) |> 
    mutate(inc = (1:n()-1)*.25,
           polygon = map2(.x = inc,
                          .y = polygon,
                          .f = \(inc,df){
                            df |> 
                              mutate(power = power + inc,
                                     or = (or - min(or))/(max(or)-min(or)))
                          }),
           model = as_factor(model)
           ) 

  plot3 <-
    temp2 |> 
    mutate(model1 = fct_rev(model)) |> 
    unnest() |>
    ggplot(aes(or, power, fill = model )) +
    geom_polygon(aes(group = model1),col = "gray10") +
    geom_label(data = temp2 |> 
                mutate(power_std = round(power_std,4),
                       y = n()/2 - inc), 
              mapping = aes(x = 0,y = y,label = power_std),
              show.legend = F,
              hjust = 0)
  
  plot4 <-
    temp2 |> 
    ggplot(aes(power,power_std)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F, col = "gray80") +
    geom_point(aes(col = model),show.legend = F) 
  
  (plot1 + plot2) / (plot3 + plot4) + 
    plot_layout(guides = "collect")
}

create_df_for_polygon <- function(powerDf, baseLineModel){
  fn_getPowerQuantile <- function(model, df, q = 0.025){
      # browser()
      uniroot(f = \(or) predict(object = model,newdata = tibble(or = or)) - q, interval = c(1, max(df$or) + 20 ) )$root
    } 
    
  fn_getPowerQuantileU <- function(model, df, q = 0.975){
    # browser()
    if(max(df$power) < .975){
      max(df$or)
    }else {
      uniroot(f = \(or) predict(object = model,newdata = tibble(or = or)) - q, interval = c(1, max(df$or) + 20 ) )$root
    }
  } 
    
    
  powerDf |> 
    nest(data = -c(mar,prev,model)) |> 
    arrange(prev,mar) |> 
    mutate(facet = sprintf("(m: %.2f)~vs~(pi: %.2f)", mar, prev),
           facet = as_factor(facet),
           ) |> 
    group_by(facet) |> 
    mutate(mps_model = map(.x = data,
                           .f = \(df) scam::scam(formula = power ~ s(or, bs="mpi"), data = df) ),
           or_025 = map2_dbl(.x = mps_model,.y = data,.f = ~ fn_getPowerQuantile(.x, .y, 0.025) ),
           or_975 = map2_dbl(.x = mps_model,.y = data,.f = ~ fn_getPowerQuantileU(.x, .y, 0.975) ),
           or_min = min(or_025),
           or_max = if_else(model == baseLineModel, NA, or_975),
           ) |> 
    mutate(model = str_replace(model,"_"," "),
           model = str_to_title(model),
           model = str_replace(model," ","-"),
           base_model = mps_model[is.na(or_max)]
           ) |> 
    mutate(polygon = pmap(.l = list(mps_model,base_model,or_min,or_975),
                                 .f = \(comp_model,base_model,or_min,or_max){
                                   or_forward <- seq(or_min,or_max,length.out = 100)
                                   or_backward <- rev(or_forward)
                                   power_forward <- predict(object = comp_model,newdata = tibble(or = c(or_forward)))
                                   power_backward <- predict(object = base_model,newdata = tibble(or = c(or_backward)))
                                   bind_rows(
                                     tibble(or = or_forward,power = power_forward),
                                     tibble(or = or_backward,power = power_backward)
                                   ) |> 
                                     mutate(power = case_when(power < 0 ~ 0,
                                                              1 < power ~ 1,
                                                              TRUE ~ power))
                                 }),
           polygon_upper = pmap(.l = list(mps_model,base_model,or_min,or_975),
                                .f = \(comp_model,base_model,or_min,or_max){
                                  or_forward <- seq(or_min,or_max,length.out = 100)
                                  power_forward <- predict(object = comp_model,newdata = tibble(or = c(or_forward)))
                                  tibble(or = or_forward,power = power_forward) |> 
                                    mutate(power = case_when(power < 0 ~ 0,
                                                             1 < power ~ 1,
                                                             TRUE ~ power))
                                  }),
           power = map_dbl(.x = polygon,
                           .f = \(df){
                             df |>
                               mutate(type = rep(c("forward","backward"),each = n()/2)) |>
                               pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = power) |>
                               summarise(LoPT = mean(abs(backward - forward)) * diff(range(or)) ) |>
                               pull()
                           }),
           power_std = map_dbl(.x = polygon,
                               .f = \(df){
                                 df |>
                                   mutate(type = rep(c("forward","backward"),each = n()/2)) |>
                                   pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = power) |>
                                   summarise(LoPT = mean(abs(backward - forward))) |>
                                   mutate(LoPT = LoPT * .95) |>
                                   pull()
                               }),
           power_diffAtOne = map_dbl(.x = polygon,
                                 .f = \(df){
                                   df |>
                                     slice_max(or) |>
                                     pull(power) |>
                                     diff()
                                 })
           )
  
}
```


```{r}
for(i in 1:length(list.files("rds_files"))){
  files <- list.files("rds_files")[i]
  
  all_plots <- 
    read_rds(sprintf("rds_files/%s",files)) |> 
    create_df_for_polygon(baseLineModel = str_extract(string = files,pattern = "(?<=model_).+(?=_sample)") ) |> 
    nest(data = -facet) |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    mutate(facet = as.character(facet),
           plot = map2(.x = facet, 
                       .y = data,
                       .f = \(label, temp1){
                         fn_plot_all(temp1) +
                           plot_annotation(title = label)
                       })
           )
  
  underlyingModel <- 
    str_extract(string = files,pattern = "(?<=model_).+(?=_sample)") |> 
    str_replace("_"," ") |> 
    str_to_title() |> 
    str_replace(" ","-")
  sampleSize <- str_extract(string = files,pattern = "(?<=_sample_).+(?=\\.rds)")
  
  (
    tibble(label = sprintf("The underlying model is %s \nwith the sample of %s.", underlyingModel, sampleSize),
           x = 0, 
           y = 0) |> 
      ggplot(aes(x,y, label = label)) +
      geom_text(size = 8) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = NULL) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = NULL) +
      labs(x = "", y = "")
    ) |> print()
  
  print(all_plots$plot)
}
```
